post.body:
Eaton, Colorado, is buzzing with excitement! This past summer, the town welcomed Route 85 Grill, a fantastic new dining destination that has quickly become a favorite among locals. This new gem offers a warm atmosphere and a menu with a range of mouthwatering dishes, showcasing the best of Eaton's local flavor.

What Makes Route 85 Grill So Special?

Delectable Dishes: At Route 85 Grill, there’s something for everyone. Whether you’re craving a juicy burger, savory BBQ, or something with a little more flair, the menu has many delicious options to satisfy any palate. Each dish is thoughtfully built to provide a dining experience that's both comforting and memorable.

Casual Vibes: The relaxed, welcoming vibe of Route 85 Grill makes it the perfect spot for any occasion. Whether you’re planning a family dinner, a laid-back date night, or a fun outing with friends, you’ll feel right at home in their cozy interior, attended by their friendly staff.

Local Flavor: Route 85 Grill isn’t just about great food; it’s about community. This is a place where neighbors can come together, share stories, and enjoy the vibrant local scene. It’s a spot to unwind and connect, truly embodying the spirit of Eaton.

Weekly Specials You Won’t Want to Miss

Route 85 Grill also offers some fantastic weekly specials to keep things fun and affordable:

  • Kids Eat Free Mondays: Every Monday from 5 to 8 PM, kids 12 and under can enjoy a free meal from the kids' menu with the purchase of an adult meal (dine-in only). It’s a great way for families to dine out without breaking the bank!

  • Senior Day Wednesdays: If you’re 60 or older, enjoy 15% off your meal every Wednesday (alcohol excluded). It’s a perfect opportunity for seniors to enjoy a tasty meal and some social time with friends.

  • Lunch Specials on Tuesdays and Thursdays: Route 85 Grill serves up delicious lunch specials every Tuesday and Thursday, perfect for a midday treat.

Starting next weekend, Route 85 Grill will be open from 11 AM to 9 PM Sunday through Thursday and from 11 AM to 10 PM on Friday and Saturday. They’re even planning to extend hours for NFL and college football games, so stay tuned!

Eaton: More Than Just Great Food

While the arrival of Route 85 Grill is certainly exciting, Eaton has so much more to offer. This charming town is a thriving hub of local businesses, community events, and a real estate market that’s catching the eye of many.

Explore Eaton:

  • Local Businesses: From quaint boutiques to cozy coffee shops, Eaton’s growing economy is full of wonderful places to explore. Supporting local businesses is a great way to experience the unique charm of this small town.

  • Real Estate: Eaton is an ideal place to call home, offering a vibrant community and a variety of beautiful homes. Whether you’re a first-time homebuyer or looking for a peaceful place to retire, Eaton has something for everyone.

  • Community Events: There’s always something happening in Eaton! From farmers' markets to holiday parades, the town’s lively community spirit is on full display at local events and gatherings.

Eaton offers the best of both worlds: the tranquility of small-town living with the convenience of being just a short drive from major hotspots like Fort Collins, Greeley, Loveland, and even Denver. Stay tuned for more updates on what's happening in Eaton, and discover why this charming town is a great place to live, work, and play.
